# Registry fixtures

Recorded on 3 Nov 2026 with free TinyFetch calls (and, for the two Agent results, the spike runs in `../spikes/out/`). Each fixture was read with the Fetch options listed here, and these are the options the adapters use in production (`recordFetchOptions` on GMC, `searchFetchOptions` on Companies House), so a fixture always shows what production reads. Every Fetch call is in the "Live TinyFish calls" table of `docs/build-log.md`.

The pages belong to the public registers they were read from, and every one that showed a person has been edited since: **no real person is named in this folder.** Each person's surname was replaced with an invented one that starts with the same letter, and each personal number (a GMC number, an NMC PIN, an SRA number) with an invented number of the same form; given names, dates, wording and layout are as recorded, which is all the parsers and the match rule need. The people named inside the two GMC record pages besides the doctor (a responsible officer) were replaced whole, and on the DCA and Sunbiz pages people are `REDACTED`. Companies keep their real names and numbers. A lookup of anyone here on the real register finds nobody.
